prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across all four rounds.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for sign-in copy changes, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Sign-in reordering changes average +2.6% after noise correction across two positive tests, with one test proving helpful (won) and one showing no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: -0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Asset Generation Progress Stage: Insert a dedicated progress screen right before waiting to display explicit asset preparation status. (why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to confusion and drop-offs.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Instant Mascot Selection Flow: Add immediate mascot preview components directly into the pet selection screen for 1-click adoption. (why: Making custom pets often stalls or takes too long, causing adoption drop-off to 60.9%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Post-Adoption Shift: Move sign-in after pet adoption certificate so users build emotional connection before account creation. (why: Lessons show sign-in reordering yields positive gains (+2.6%), while initial sign-in causes drop-off.)
3: [adoption, copy] Adoption Fast Track Copy: Update adoption certificate screen copy to emphasize fast 60-second adoption setup. (why: Adoption step takes up to 89s median, creating user uncertainty around setup completion time.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Display Permission Hint: Add a prominent system permission hint on the final screen explaining desktop overlay settings. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop or the app failing to open.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Room Timer & Animation: Add visual timer component and dynamic progress bar to the asset waiting screen. (why: The waiting step mean time is 2336s (median 201s), causing users to abandon during generation.)
6: [home, notification] Background Preparation Alert: Enable system notification prompt on waiting screen so users can minimize while waiting. (why: Median wait time of 201s leads to app abandonment if users switch tasks without notifications.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Split View Path Selection Layout: Switch path selection from list layout to a split two-column layout for side-by-side comparison. (why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s, indicating decision paralysis from layout clutter.)

scores.note: High wait times on home step show drop-off, but requires a new progress screen.
Adoption has high drop-off (60.9%), but adoption redesign evidence is still very thin.
Sign-in reordering has historical positive average lift (+2.6%) across tests.
Low-cost copy change on adoption step, but copy changes historically yield minimal lift.
Directly backed by 3 support emails and finish screen drop-off; low implementation cost.
Addresses high median wait time on home screen with visual progress indicators.
Helps re-engage users switching tasks during long asset generation wait times.
Path selection has reasonable conversion (76.2%), layout change may reduce decision time.
